provenance.paper_title: VisMem: Latent Vision Memory Unlocks Potential of Vision-Language Models

representation_paths.memory_component: short-term perceptual and long-term semantic latent tokens

evidence.paraphrase: Special invocation tokens route a context-conditioned query to short- or long-term memory formers, whose generated latent vision tokens are inserted into the autoregressive stream.

Trained short- and long-term formers generate new latent memory tokens from visual evidence and current hidden-state queries during inference. For VisMem, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of short-term perceptual and long-term semantic latent tokens.

derived.hybrid_relation: Both tiers use the same operative latent-token representation.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): Offline RL trains the memory invocation and formation policy. Deployment uses frozen formers to update latent memory tokens, so this is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
